usedFor: Shopify holds your products and TextRazor reads text, so “New Product” can send the listing to “Analyze Text”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Analyze Text” in TextRazor
bestTemplate.why: A new product’s description is analyzed for entities and topics, so you can review what the listing is about.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so “Analyze Text” on it follows a scheduled check, not the moment a customer leaves.
